requirements.observations: All ten views show a complete, centered spherical silhouette with a dense, visually smooth tessellation; no clipping, holes, merged geometry, or unintended features are visible.

views.observations: Centered circular silhouette; smooth dense surface shading; no clipping, holes, or unintended features.
Opposing rear view matches the front silhouette and proportions; complete and unclipped.
Left profile is circular, centered, and visually smooth with no missing geometry.
Right profile agrees with the left view; silhouette is complete and unclipped.
Top view shows a centered circular outline and regular radial tessellation without defects.
Bottom view is complete and symmetric with the top view; the lower pole is present and unclipped.
Upper front isometric shows a smooth sphere with consistent curvature and generous frame clearance.
Upper rear isometric agrees with the front isometric; no seams, holes, or distortion are visible.
Underside front isometric clearly shows the intact lower hemisphere and pole with no clipping or open surface.
Underside rear isometric confirms a complete lower hemisphere and consistent opposing geometry.
